title: Round fractional preparation units upward
description: The pantry.py planner rescales indivisible ingredient units, such as scoops. A rounding refactor sometimes underestimates the units needed. Repair rescale_units(recipe, from_servings, to_servings). recipe is a mapping of at most 100 arbitrary Unicode ingredient strings (including empty) to whole-number JSON quantities from 0 through 1000000. from_servings is a whole-number JSON value from 1 through 1000; to_servings is from 0 through 1000. Whole-number JSON values mean finite integral numbers after JSON transport, excluding booleans; no Python int-versus-float distinction is promised. None/null, nonintegral numbers, other shapes, and inputs outside the stated bounds are outside this retained contract.

requirements.text: For a positive target serving count, retain every recipe key and return the least integer greater than or equal to units * to_servings / from_servings for each key. An original zero quantity remains zero.
With to_servings equal to zero, retain all recipe keys with quantity zero. An empty recipe returns {} for every supported serving count.
Do not change the recipe mapping in content, including when scaling changes one or more ingredient quantities.

provenance: Original independent AI-authored batch-preparation library; author job repo05, repository owned-v2-r05; CC0-1.0. No upstream code or data.
